title: Bar Drop Malaysian Mango 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Malaysian Mango by Drop captures the specific, highly-prized profile of Asian mango varieties. It is intensely sweet, rich, and creamy, offering a deep tropical flavour that feels almost nectar-like on the palate. Unlike greener mango blends, this focuses purely on the ripe, golden sweetness of the fruit. Mixed with a 40% VG / 60% PG ratio, this e-liquid delivers the heavy, sweet mango notes with incredible intensity while maintaining a relatively thin consistency perfect for pod coils. Ideally suited for MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) hardware, the nicotine salt formulation provides a smooth draw in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. Bar Drop Salts are brought to you by Drop and are manufactured right here in the UK. Drop’s collections focus on fabulously fruity flavours that are achingly authentic and blend familiar favourites with unique profiles.
